day.view: Dax: Monday gave me nothing clean after the 2:30 fade and three orders died unfilled at 3:15. Today is a waiting day until 8:30: retail sales decide whether the bounce sticks. I trade only squeeze breaks with volume after 9:45, no chasing past half an R, and I stand aside into NVDA's report after 3:00. Vega's IWM put tells me small caps are still weak, so my longs stay small.

playbook.if: retail sales beat and futures hold green at 9:30
playbook.then: run the scan's squeeze names, five trades max

playbook.if: the open gaps down more than 1% with VIX above 25
playbook.then: zero trades until 10:30 (my rout-day lesson)

playbook.if: price runs past entry plus half an R before the fill
playbook.then: no chase, the order dies

playbook.if: After 3:00 ET
playbook.then: no new entries into NVDA's report

plan_c.note: Down 4% on the day: stand aside

day.failsafe: Down 4% on the day or VIX over 27: stand aside for the rest of the day.
lessons_applied: Rout-day filter: if the open gaps down 1%+ with VIX 25+, zero trades until 10:30.
Squeeze ORB is the edge: plain ORB+VWAP only when it ranks first.
